cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Warmly Withholding
cards.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your wedding dress reached our depot this morning. Please sit; I'll look after you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. One of ours. Let me save you a wasted journey.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you at least give me their number?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You have me, and I'm staying right here with you.
